scripts.duplicates: bun --bun jscpd --config .jscpd.json || { echo 'duplicates: extract the shared code into one function or module and import it from both places; a clone that must stay goes between // jscpd:ignore-start <reason> and // jscpd:ignore-end, with bin/duplicate-disables.txt raised'; exit 1; }
scripts.unused: bun --bun knip --config knip.config.ts --no-progress || { echo 'unused: delete it or stop exporting it; when it is used in a way the checker cannot see, mark it knipignore with a reason and raise bin/unused-disables.txt'; exit 1; }
scripts.imports: bun --bun depcruise src tests tooling --config .dependency-cruiser.mjs --output-type err-long || { echo 'imports: fix each import as its rule says; a one-off that must stay is a pathNot entry on that rule with // import-exception: <reason>, and bin/import-disables.txt raised'; exit 1; }
